title: Somehow
subtitle: Still Building
author: rithythul
summary: Somehow: Still Building follows the people, choices, and companies around smallworld in Cambodia. A book by rithythul, in English and Khmer.
homeNote: Some mentors never knew they were teaching.
description: Somehow is about the people and the work around smallworld, and the companies connected with it.
An interest in Linux. An idea for a coding space. The connections only made sense later.
The money ran out more than once. Each time, something small kept it going.
The work is not finished, and neither is the book. It is being written in English and Khmer.
